prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” healthcare marketing agency for everyone — the right agency depends on your organization’s size, specialty, goals, budget and preferred working style. I can help you find the best fit. To start, here are practical ways to evaluate and pick the right healthcare marketing partner in St. Louis (or nearby):

Key criteria to use
- Healthcare experience: case studies with hospitals, practices, med device firms, or whatever matches your sector. Look for HIPAA/privacy experience.
- Measurable outcomes: examples of patient volume growth, lead cost reductions, improved referral patterns, or ROI metrics.
- Services you need: SEO, paid search/paid social, website UX, conversion-rate optimization, CRM/inbound, content for clinicians/patients, reputation management, physician outreach, internal communications, or branding.
- Regulatory knowledge: experience with healthcare advertising rules and state/federal requirements.
- Team and process: who will own the account, reporting cadence, and how they measure success.
- Technology & integrations: experience with EHR/CRM, marketing automation, analytics platforms you use.
- Local market knowledge: familiarity with St. Louis patient demographics and referral networks (important for community hospitals and practices).
- References and longevity: talk to current/past healthcare clients.

Questions to ask prospective agencies
- Which healthcare clients have you worked with and what were the outcomes?
- How do you measure patient acquisition and ROI?
- What is your experience with HIPAA-compliant campaigns and PHI handling?
- Who will be on our project team and what are their backgrounds?
- Can you show a similar case study and provide references?
- What is your typical retainer/project pricing and contract terms?

Typical scope + budget ranges (ballpark)
- Small practices — project or ongoing retainer: $2k–7k/month
- Mid-size organizations or specialty groups: $7k–20k/month
- Large health systems or integrated campaigns: $20k+/month
(Prices vary widely based on services and media spend.)

If you want, I can:
- Research and shortlist 3–5 St. Louis-area agencies with proven healthcare experience and summarize their strengths and case studies.
- Or recommend national healthcare-specialty firms if you’re open to remote partners.

Tell me: what type of healthcare organization are you (hospital system, single clinic, dental, med device, behavioral health, etc.), what are your main goals, and what’s your monthly marketing budget? I’ll pull a tailored short list.
